Cached mutual rank transformation

Source: R/RcppExports.R
mutual_rank_transform_cached_cpp.Rd

Transforms a correlation matrix using mutual rank normalization.

Usage

mutual_rank_transform_cached_cpp(sim, log_transform = FALSE, n_cores = 1L)

Arguments

sim

Symmetric correlation/similarity matrix (n x n)

log_transform

If FALSE (default), uses raw mutual rank with ascending ranks (original Rmd formula). If TRUE, applies Obayashi & Kinoshita (2009) log-normalized formula with descending ranks (values in 0 to 1 range).

n_cores

Number of OpenMP threads (default: 1)

Value

Mutual rank normalized matrix (n x n)

Details

When log_transform = TRUE: $$S_{ij} = 1 - \log(\sqrt{R_{ij} \cdot R_{ji}}) / \log(n)$$ where ranks are descending (highest correlation = rank 1).

When log_transform = FALSE: $$MR_{ij} = \sqrt{R_{ij} \cdot R_{ji}}$$ where ranks are ascending (lowest correlation = rank 1), matching the original RComPlEx R Markdown formula.
